result.topic_en: Scratch calculations for a correction per degree (Fahrenheit/Réaumur) of a thermometric or pendulum quantity, with notes on warm above and below, and a small table of values with logarithmic computation.

methods.what: Conversion of a per-degree correction from one temperature scale to another (multiplying by the degree ratio 1.25 / 2.25)
Cubic relation for an angle phi set equal to a given quantity
Logarithmic computation (doubling a logarithm, adding a constant, taking antilog) to obtain 0.00689
Table of angles corresponding to values 0.005 to 0.045
Long multiplication by hand of 18555 by 2.25 giving 41749
